s1.desc: a living room drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: 16 frames: Pax lies alone on the cream sofa. A heart icon with a scrolling heartbeat (ECG) line is drawn over the picture above him, f0-15. The whole skit carries this graphic, see span 2

18 frames: Polly stands alone hugging a bundled blanket, a heart icon with a heartbeat line drawn above her, f16-33. Hard cut at f34 was not in profile's hard-cut list (it showed up only as a gradual-change candidate, d1 6.9); placed with a step-1 strip

spans.view: with a cream sofa with yellow scallop-shell armrests and a pillow at one end

beats.text: Polly stands beside the sofa hugging a bundled coral blanket while Pax lies on his back on the sofa, head on a pillow
Polly waddles to the end of the sofa, dragging the blanket behind her, and turns to face the seat
Polly climbs up onto the sofa seat, hauling the blanket up with her
Polly kneels on the seat and shuffles toward Pax holding the blanket up, while Pax lies still looking up
Polly lies down on top of Pax and spreads the blanket over both of them
Polly snuggles her cheek against Pax's face with her eyes closed while Pax lies under her with his eyes open
Pax wraps a flipper around Polly and closes his eyes
Pax and Polly lie still under the blanket with their eyes closed, cuddling on the sofa

spans.notes: A heart icon plus scrolling heartbeat (ECG) line is drawn over the picture above the sofa on every frame f34-167: two lines (one per lead, in their colours) until ~f112, merging f112-135 into one red heart with a single line f136-167. Read as a meter / UI overlay -> graphic_overlay. Camera locked (compare 34/167: sofa edges overlap). No meme caption or watermark. All kept-span fields filled so the span can be flipped if the heartbeat graphic is ruled an allowed in-style effect. Blanket pattern is fish, not a lead print
